name: Capt. Moore
mentions: …any “savvey” as the Greasers say, about writing for a newspaper and is an innocent cuss in this matter. Frank Moore is also blamed, but the smarties are just as far off about him. “How” is a man who could just about fill Geary Paddock's clothes.  Many distinguished guests have come to…
Capt. Moore and son Frank, left Sunday morning for Minneapolis. Frank expects to obtain the post-tradership at Ft. Mead.
